messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a road, then turns and begins to walk forward, swinging their arms.","camera":"A medium shot from behind the character that slowly pushes in as they move.","clothing":"A light plaid button-up shirt with brown leather suspenders and dark, distressed jeans with brown boots.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, seen from behind.","scene":"An outdoor paved road on a sunny day, with a street lamp, a guardrail, and trees with yellow and green leaves in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the character from behind on a paved road, starting in a full-body rear view and gradually pushing in to an upper-body framing. The character's blue ponytail, plaid shirt, brown suspenders, dark jeans, and walking motion are retained.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a rear-view dolly-in from full-body to upper-body framing, matching the reference for viewing direction, subject placement, and starting framing, while preserving the character's identity, hair, clothing, action, timing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the action timing and progression exactly match the source video.
unexpected_changes: The scene background changed from the source's rocky garden/fence area to a road with a street lamp, guardrail, and yellow-leafed trees.
